votes.motion: Council Member Prokopis, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to approve the minutes of the Magna Metro Township Council meeting held on August 23, 2022
Council Member Pierce, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to have Council Member Barney’s comments read into the record

Council Member Prokopis made a motion to approve the Resolution. Council Member Pierce asked to allow the community and contractor to speak to this issue. DATE TUESDAY SEPTEMBER 27, 2022 Kerri Duckworth stated it is nice to see someone taking care of the cemetery. There are times in the past where there were weeds everywhere and she could not see the headstones. She appreciates the hard work N&W LLC have done there and does not think the Council needs to go anywhere else when a good company is willing to take it on
Council Member Prokopis, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to approve Resolution 22-09-03, with the expectation that the contract will be revisited to make necessary amendments
Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to adopt Ordinance 22-O-07
